title: GPT-5
before: Users chose between a fast chat model and a slow reasoning model, and mostly chose wrong.
problem: Model selection is a burden users should not carry and cannot do well.
breakthrough: A unified system with a router that decides per request how much reasoning to spend.
why: It ended the model-picker era and made reasoning depth an automatic decision rather than a user's.
inherits: Routing between capability tiers behind one name.
